events.title: Coty’s Interim CEO Gives Updates on Gucci License, Orveda Stores and CoverGirl’s Gen X Push
events.body: Markus Strobel outlines Coty’s strategic moves, including discussions on the Gucci license transfer, winding down Orveda operations, and repositioning CoverGirl for Gen X shoppers.
